title: Hakoniwa Robot Runtime sensor output
description: How measured values of named sensors are published. The sensors are defined separately (sensor-instances.schema.json). The Runtime checks at start-up that every name exists and that the sensor types fit the message type (sensor_msgs/JointState: joint sensors, one entry per sensor in the listed order; geometry_msgs/WrenchStamped: exactly one force-torque sensor; sensor_msgs/Imu: exactly one IMU; frame_id is the sensor name).
